fusions.name: Thrown Net
fusions.desc: Casts a weighted net over everything within 4 tiles ahead for 8 damage, stunning each target for 1 second and leaving it [Slowed] for 4 seconds.

fusions.name: Through the Mesh
fusions.desc: Needs one of your afflictions on the target and uses it up: a weapon strike through the mesh for 7 piercing damage that leaves the target [Bleeding] for 2 damage a second for 3 seconds.

fusions.name: Wrapped Haft
fusions.desc: Wraps the haft to turn blows: a barrier absorbs the next 18 damage for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Footwork on the Sand
fusions.desc: Your dodge chance rises by 10% against enemies carrying your afflictions.
